content: GOAL: orient before proposing. READ: directory listing of task workspace. OBSERVED: starting reconnaissance. OPEN: what reference arrays exist.

FINAL ANSWER. GOAL: one hyperbolic SID-table metric beating Q_H(+0.634)/HBAA(+0.701), distinct from the refuted family. READ: contract, 97-pair results, HBAA controls, path-likelihood failure (-0.49, collapse-driven). OBSERVED: only the frozen reference used as a CONTRAST survives; partition-intrinsic geometry and single-anchor margin/likelihood/coverage all failed or tied HBAA. REASONING: replace HBAA's mean-of-ten-negatives with the full cell distribution (temperatured expected rank over all K level-1 cells), replace the single anchor positive with the cell's target-side Frechet barycentre, keep the training-history tangent-space barycentre as query, and divide by the exact random-assignment expected rank (K-1)/2 so bucket count and collapse cannot inflate. Constants derived: c=1, tau=median d(q_i,t_i) from the reference, 10 Karcher steps, (K-1)/2 null. METRIC=hyp_cell_expected_rank (HERC). Formula: B_1^d; d(x,y)=2 artanh||(-x)(+)y||. nu_k = Karcher barycentre in B_1^d of target points t_i in cell k (10 exp/log iterations). q_i = exp_0(mean_{j in H_i} log_0 s_j). D_ik=d(q_i,nu_k). tau=median_i d(q_i,t_i). p_i=softmax_k(-D_ik/tau). r_i(k)=1+#{k':D_ik'<D_ik}+0.5 ties. Rbar=mean_i sum_k p_i(k)r_i(k). HERC=1-(Rbar-1)/((K-1)/2), K>=2; 0 if K=1. Chance=0 at every K, perfect=1. INPUTS: level-1 codes, frozen reference s_i,t_i, training split. GEOMETRY: c=1 enters via Frechet barycentres inside the ball, tangent-space query pushed back by exp_0, and Poincare distances with boundary-shrinking conformal factor. WHY TRACKS RECALL: scores the expected rank of the true target's semantic cell over ALL K cells; positive is the whole cell (robust when its anchor is off), negatives are the full distribution (a uniformly second-best cell still loses), and the analytic null makes it bucket-count-proof - the size-matched null whose absence drove the likelihood to -0.49. COMPUTE: 24587x256=6.3M Poincare distances, numpy ~20s, plus K Karcher means ~2s; under a minute, no fitting. RISKS: tau too large flattens softmax toward 0 everywhere; large cells dominate barycentres; near-duplicate nu_k cause ties; K=2 is coarse. FAILURE MODE: radially degenerate table with random but geometrically centred codes - all nu_k collapse near the origin, D_ik equal, p uniform, Rbar=(K+1)/2, HERC=0; one-code table 0; cleanly separated but semantically wrong table scores <=0, where bucket count and covering radius were fooled. OPEN: Spearman on the 97 pairs, tau sensitivity. END METRIC
